title: Divers Find What May Be the World’s Oldest Shipwreck
paragraphs: Divers found an old ship under the sea. It is near Kekova, west of Antalya in Turkey. The ship may be 4,500 years old.
The wood is gone. But many big clay jars are still there. The jars are called amphorae. People used them to carry oil or wine.
Hakan Öniz found the place in 2024. He works at Akdeniz University. Scientists want to learn more about the jars.
